BACKTESTS.TITLE: Backtests
BACKTESTS.IMPORT_ERROR: Something went wrong while importing the backtests.
BACKTESTS.RUNS_ERROR: Could not load backtest runs. Check the API connection and try again.
BACKTESTS.CALIBRATIONS_ERROR: Could not load symbol calibrations. Check the API connection and try again.
BACKTESTS.IMPORT_HINT: Backtests are imported from a strategy's row on its account page.
BACKTESTS.SOURCE_PLATFORM_HINT: Which platform produced these trade lists. Recorded as provenance and never inferred — an undeclared run stays undeclared.
BACKTESTS.SOURCE_PLATFORM_UNDECLARED_NOTE: These runs will be recorded without a platform.
BACKTESTS.IMPORT_INTRO: Each slot is optional and can be re-imported on its own. The slot you choose is what tells the system which artifact the file is — nothing in the file itself says so.
BACKTESTS.SLOT_DEPLOY_HINT: AlgoWizard export using the parameters currently running. Used for sizing, correlation and risk — never for an out-of-sample claim.
BACKTESTS.SLOT_EVALUATION_HINT: AlgoWizard export using the PREVIOUS walk-forward window's parameters. Its trades after the boundary date are genuinely out of sample.
BACKTESTS.SLOT_WALK_FORWARD_HINT: SQX Optimizer → Walk-Forward Results → Export. Supplies the out-of-sample boundary date and the per-window KPIs.

GROUP_RISK.TITLE: Group risk (backtest)
GROUP_RISK.HINT: Correlation and VaR over the strategies below, computed over one named sample of simulated closes.
GROUP_RISK.REQUEST_ERROR: The group risk analysis could not be requested.
GROUP_RISK.APPROXIMATION_DISCLAIMER: Approximate: figures are gross of commission, swap and taxes, which the backtest rows do not carry.
GROUP_RISK.WITHHELD_NO_SERIES: Withheld: no dated series was produced
GROUP_RISK.WITHHELD_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: Withheld: shorter than the ninety-day history floor
GROUP_RISK.WITHHELD_INSUFFICIENT_NEGATIVE_OBSERVATI: Withheld: too few losing observations for this percentile to land on a loss
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_SEGMENT_NOT_SPECIFIED: No sample was selected. Every figure would otherwise be silently in-sample.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_UNKNOWN_SEGMENT: Unknown is not a selectable sample: it marks a label the importer could not classify.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND: One of the named strategies does not exist.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_INVALID_LOT_GRID: The lot grid is not valid, so nothing can be resized onto it.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_INVALID_INITIAL_CAPITAL: The initial capital must be greater than zero: it is the denominator of every percentage in this analysis.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_RUN_SEGMENTS_DISAGREE: A run holds trades from more than one sample. Those rows were edited outside the importer.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_NO_EVIDENCE: No run carries the requested sample, so there is no evidence for it.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_AMBIGUOUS_RUN: Both run slots carry the requested sample. Name a run slot to disambiguate.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_RISK_NOT_ESTIMABLE: The run's own risk per trade could not be estimated from its stop-loss closes.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_NON_UNIT_WEIGHT: A member carries an allocation weight other than one, which would double-size an already-sized series.
GROUP_RISK.STATUS_HETEROGENEOUS: The members' runs do not share one sample, so no figure carries a true label.

BACKTESTS.SLOT_NAMING_HINT: A convention for you, not for the app: the file name is stored for audit and never read to decide anything. Double underscore separates fields, single hyphen joins words inside one. Both trade lists come from AlgoWizard — the Optimizer’s own walk-forward trade list mixes in-sample and out-of-sample rows and is refused.

RISK.BREACH_BASIS_CLOSED_TRADE_LOWER_BOUND: Lower bound (closed trades only) — not the broker's verdict
RISK.BREACH_BASIS_VAR_QUANTILE: VaR95 comparison, not a real daily loss

FTMO_SIMULATION.NO_RUN_HELD: No run held for this slot
FTMO_SIMULATION.NO_BACKTESTS_IMPORTED: This strategy has no imported backtests. Import its Deploy and Evaluation backtests with the Import backtests action on the strategy row.
FTMO_SIMULATION.DISCLOSURE_ALWAYS_VISIBLE: This simulation models elimination against FTMO limits from historical backtest data. It is not a certification, and a favorable result does not guarantee a real funded outcome.
FTMO_SIMULATION.DISCLOSURE_RESULT: Consecutive monthly starts share most of their trades, so they are not independent trials. These figures describe this backtest; they are not probabilities or a forecast. Unmodelled swap and closed-trade replay make targets easier to reach and understate breaches. The funded phase models no reward withdrawal and no Scaling Plan, which keeps profit as cushion; that omission is also optimistic.
FTMO_SIMULATION.BEFORE_RUN_HINT: Enter the risk per trade and press Run to see results.
FTMO_SIMULATION.START1_DIFFERS_DISCLOSURE: Start 1 differs from the single-start anchor.
